retainedBundleComparison.method: Serve the original performance-ldkYaY/bundle unchanged through Vite preview on 127.0.0.1:4297. No rebuild, constructor probes, or catch instrumentation.

nativeSafari.observation: Native CUA navigation, then two reloads. Each run displayed the final initializationMs/cases result, which the retained fixture emits only after all assertions finish. First result was additionally inspected in a screenshot through the last 500-item repetition. Accessibility text truncates the result; no complete machine-readable native JSON was collected.

bundledWebKit.observation: Each fresh browser opened the same served bytes, waited for #result[data-status], then read status passed and all nine result cases. Complete results are retained in this task's command output, not a separate report file.

limits: Both native Safari and bundled WebKit passed this bounded comparison; this does not isolate the cause or prove the original intermittent failure fixed.
These engines differ in version and execution environment; this is not a controlled engine-version comparison.
Native and bundled runs may overlap. Timings are not used as performance evidence.
The retained bundle uses the previous Rust candidate, deliberately, to preserve the failed artifact.
